environment.client_transport: bundled rusqlite, one embedded connection per concurrency slot, cached prepared statements, autocommit per statement

comparability.seed_policy: seed-{index}, tenant benchmark-tenant, index modulo seed count
comparability.document_policy: seed documents have id seed-{index}, name user-{index}, group index modulo 100, 256-byte payload
comparability.operation_policy: mixed uses index modulo 10: 0..4 read, 5..7 write, 8..9 query; read/query address index modulo seed count
comparability.write_id_policy: measured writes use measured-{global operation index}
comparability.durability_semantics: WAL journal with synchronous=FULL and a five-second busy timeout; autocommit statement acknowledgement
comparability.server_configuration_provenance: bundled sqlite at shipped defaults plus WAL, synchronous=FULL, busy_timeout=5000ms

limits: embedded reference: the measured member is this driver's own process, so the load generator and the database share one resource envelope
single writer at a time; concurrent writers serialize on the WAL write lock through the five-second busy timeout
